book.name: Matyu
book.title: Matyu Matyhuho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Yesuho omocdecma wekongga idonggoc
Oro Sabat sep bongono urop bödeuna Söndain kembotsum sinom bongono wocin Maria Makdalama woroc ot Maria auma yu sop ganango Yesu idocma woroc acacha ebomoroc.

Engga idinya Morömahon sum yaru au yu mom imun fauna gurocdec ohogoc. Ohuna konoc moröma sinom fendoc. Tuna sum yaru yu sop moröma sop ganango foc togocma woroc ibaruna onguna momböngno eran idoc. Tuna inoi sop koroc omoc idoc.
Yaru worochon godibo wömai mom muruc muruc simbang möngga idoc. O tecno wömai föhöc tiptip sinom ais kiap.
Oro tawa amna yu yaru woroc angbotongga kudat konoc konoc toup sinom tongo amna omima simbang tongga idung.
Tuna yaruho owi yaima ingoroc inogoc, “Sot botodimorocha. Noc kombihat sot ‘Yesu, ep goröcdec wodungma yu ada’ yongo ebamoroc.
Wohong yu ngocin maec. Yu urop osuc kanongdegocmahon toroc wekongga idonggoc. Sot engmunya dupdup abamo aarun.

Angga sot karupgon ongga Yesuhon youp amnani ingoroc inarun: Yu urop amna fiima imun fauna wekongga idonggoc. Tongo yu Galili guroc woce osuc fat kamuna sontho ihorocgon woce ongga anahing. Oro noc epatma wömai mata woroc kanoc kanocha epat,” Sum yaruho owi yai ihoroc inogoc.
Tuna owi yaima yu botogomoroc mahong aramokene toup sinom borongdedomoroc. Tongo yu karupgon amna fiima woroc imun fauna ‘Yesuhon youp amnani fat woroc inoda’ yongo domdomgon onggomoroc.
Uyapdec ongidinya wohogon Yesu yu yaun feuna inogoc, “Kembotsum ogep.” Ihoroc inuna owi yai yu ambehecgon engmunya orungo sogitmunya yong moröng imogomoroc.
Tunya Yesuho inogoc, “Sot botodimorocha. Sot ongmunya nakain oröcnai inarun, ‘Son Galili gurocin ongorut. Tongo woce wömai noc nanahing.’”
Tawa amna sop ganango angtoregungma yuhon yongburoc mata
Oro owi yaima yu uyapdec ongidinya tawa amna sop ganango gön togungma au yu Yerusalem ongmuya manomano öngkubocmahon fatno öret socsoc amna moröma inongdup togung.
Ihoroc tuya öret socsoc amna moröma yu onguya surarohon amna dugo ot suran tongmuya mata yong torop sigung. Tongo yu tawa amna möneng koböcma sinom imongmuya inogung,
“Son owi amna ingoroc inarut: ‘Non kumbong dungo iditnaya Yesuhon youp amnaniho engmuya ep fambangno usem tongo tonging.’
Oro mata ngorocho Gavman morömahon onggimon ohuna kombingga yunai wömai nontho yuot matasoni woroc tobinahamon. Son worocha kombingbanac toninga.”

Ihoroc inuya tawa amna yu möneng woroc sogida amna morömahon mata worocgon tanda yong fandat tonguya mata worocho Yuda nanohon bonipnodec furang kango onggoc. Tuna Yuda nano koböcmaho mata worocgon kombingidung, o ihorocgon önga kombing tobingidang.
Yesuho youp amnani youp mata inogoc
Oro mit wömai Yesuhon youp amnani 11 yu Galili gurocin ongga sa urongo audec ögung. Yesuho osucgon ‘woce ongorut’ yongo inogoc.
Woce öngkungga Yesu au feuna yong moröng imogung. Wohong auho irot yai togung.
Oro Yesu yu ambehegon engmuna ingoroc inogoc, “Kopotorocho ‘noc mom orin guroc manomano ambarachon Morömo itiwa’ yongo worochon gesö ambarac namogoc.
Worocha sonu ‘owi amna nakain youp amnanai itnung’ yongo gurocno gurocno ongmuya Nandöng orin Manano orin Kunkun Yaru yuhon madec yamuc gung imongitnung.
Tongo nocho fatmata fandat kanogotma woroc ambarac yu fandat inuya yu kombingo sumboditnung. Kombiarut, nocho bongono bongono sonot itong tongeyagon ongga guroc ngorochon bongono bödeangoc.”
